```yaml
apiVersion: argocd-image-updater.argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: ImageUpdater
metadata:
  name: filebrowser-iu
spec:
  namespace: argocd
  applicationRefs:
    - namePattern: "filebrowser"
      images:
        - alias: "filebrowser"
          imageName: "ghcr.io/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser:0.x"
      writeBackConfig:
        method: "git"
        gitConfig:
          repository: "https://github.com/dvystrcil/filebrowser-quantum.git"
          branch: "main"
          writeBackTarget: "kustomization:/overlays"
```
